scope: Manual provenance review of dynamic display expressions without direct translation calls; follows concrete producers in listed sources. Not an exhaustive review of all composed translated expressions or external provider strings.

groups.classification: Locale-formatted numbers and percent sign; parameter captions through i18n::text; addRow(widget) expressions are widget placement, not untranslated prose.

Profile names, source, conditions and provenance are imported/user metadata. Owned require diagnostics use i18n::text before throwing; displayed std::exception text originates at this boundary. Button/ask helper label/title arguments must be checked at callers, not inferred from parameter names.
Language/territory autonyms and BCP47 tags intentionally identify languages; these are not English-owned captions.
Title arguments forward caller-translated captions; declaration signatures and native delegation are inventory false positives.
remind(message) receives translated owned update templates; filenames/version tags remain opaque.

Setup finish messages originate from SC_TR or audioSetupOutput mapping. Calibration status comes from localized child worker messages through bounded UTF-8 buffering. Conflict reason originates from translated processing guard. Speaker details use translated display helpers with opaque model/source metadata; device descriptions and custom preset keys retain system/user identity. Numeric gain/frequency captions use QLocale. Synthetic multilingual setItemText belongs only to fixture.

remaining: External MIME/Windows file association descriptions follow provider behavior
Whole-interface proof also requires checking display sinks outside this lexical inventory

composedCaptionReview.scope: Expressions in dynamic inventory containing translation calls plus concatenation/arg composition; manually inspect producers for setup, microphone status, speaker details, numeric labels, accessibility captions and update panel. Source review does not substitute for every live device workflow.
reviewedBoundaries: Microphone disconnect notice and USB hint are translated complete sentences/fragments; device description remains opaque
Speaker/amplifier metadata remains opaque; profile selection suffixes and filter/detail helpers translate owned captions
Tray tooltip uses invariant application name plus translated equalizer status
Translated gain labels use locale numeric strings; band accessibility counts and coverage totals corrected in latest source
Balance label uses translated Center/L/R with locale digits and percent sign
Setup errorString is external Qt/system diagnostic inside translated app template
Installed version is stable version metadata in translated template
composedCaptionReview.result: No further owned English prose found in reviewed composed expressions; current runtime/package results still require qualification

expandedSinksReview.tableHeaders: Equipment headers Type/Frequency Hz/Gain dB translated; Q is standard filter quality-factor symbol. Studio table helper callers translate Type/Input channel/Gain polarity/Channel/Peak; Hz/dB/Q remain unit symbols.
expandedSinksReview.trayMessages: Owned title/body translate at call sites; update reminder body traced through update_panel templates.
expandedSinksReview.directoryTitles: Update download folder caption translated at caller; FileDialogs forwards caller title.
expandedSinksReview.suffixes: Enhancement metadata contains only standard Hz/s/ms/dB/dBFS, multiplication and ratio symbols, or empty units.
expandedSinksReview.menuConstructor: QMenu(this) supplies a parent widget, not a visible title.
expandedSinksReview.qualification: Source review only; current installed package checks pending.
